bio: Hello! I am Asma Shehzadi, known as 'The Editor'. With over 5 years of professional experience, I blend pacing, sound design, motion graphics, and color grading into seamless visual journeys that hold audience attention from the first second.

Whether it is an ultra-retention TikTok/Instagram reel, a story-driven YouTube documentary, a dynamic talking-head episode, or sleek visual branding, I focus on what makes content memorable and high-performing.

testimonials.reviewText: Asma is easily one of the best video editors I've ever hired. Our YouTube channel retention jumped from 38% to 62% in just two weeks after she took over the editing and pacing. Her sound design is unmatched!

She turned our simple phone clips into viral masterpieces on Instagram and TikTok. Three of our reels crossed 1 million views each within a month. Communication was super smooth and lightning fast delivery!
Working with The Editor was a breath of fresh air. She understood our brand guidelines immediately, crafted incredible motion graphics, and designed thumbnails that outperformed our previous agency.
The color grading and luxury aesthetic Asma brought to our property showcases elevated our entire brand perception. High-ticket buyers constantly compliment our video presentation.
Asma's edits are snappy without feeling chaotic. She highlights the jokes and pivotal quotes with pinpoint audio cues and kinetic subtitles. Highly recommend her for any serious creator!

blocks.content: Every frame is sculpted with intent. From correcting exposure and balancing skin tones to applying rich cinematic LUTs and removing background noise, your raw footage is elevated to broadcast quality.

dynamicSections.title: My 4-Step Editing Process
dynamicSections.subtitle: From initial briefing to the polished 4K final delivery, here is how we bring your vision to life.

blocks.subcontent: We discuss your project goals, audience, target platform, and pacing style. You upload raw files and audio safely via Google Drive or Dropbox.
I assemble the narrative backbone, trim dead space, curate the best takes, and structure the video hook for maximum retention.
Adding kinetic text, B-roll overlays, bespoke sound effects, music sync, atmospheric risers, and cinematic color correction.
You review the draft, request any micro adjustments, and receive the finalized high-bitrate video ready to publish.

dynamicSections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
dynamicSections.subtitle: Got questions before starting? Find quick answers right here.

blocks.content: What video editing software do you use?
blocks.subcontent: I primarily use Adobe Premiere Pro for editing and pacing, Adobe After Effects for motion graphics and visual effects, DaVinci Resolve for advanced color grading, and Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator for graphic design and thumbnails.

blocks.content: How do I send my raw video files to you?
blocks.subcontent: You can upload your files to Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, or Frame.io and share the link. I handle large video file transfers efficiently.

blocks.content: What is your standard turnaround time?
blocks.subcontent: For short-form reels and TikToks, delivery is typically 24-48 hours. Long-form YouTube videos and commercial projects range between 3 to 5 business days depending on complexity.

blocks.content: Do you offer revisions if I need changes?
blocks.subcontent: Yes! Every project includes up to 2 rounds of free revisions to ensure you are 100% delighted with the timing, sound design, and text.
